nodes.name: Definition 2.1: MFE $\mathbb{E}[V_t^{*,f}]=\mathrm{v}_0+\int_0^t f(s)ds$ see
nodes.statement: For a given function $f\in{\tt{C}}([0,T])$, let $(\theta^{*,f},C^{*,f})=(\theta_t^{*,f},C_t^{*,f})_{t\in[0,T]}\in \mathbb{U}$ be the best response solution to the stochastic control problem (2.5) for the representative agent. The strategy $(\theta^{*,f},C^{*,f})$ is called a mean field equilibrium (MFE) if it is the best response to itself such that $\mathbb{E}[V_t^{*,f}]=\mathrm{v}_0+\int_0^t f(s)ds$ for all $t\in[0,T]$, where $V^{*,f}=(V_t^{*,f})_{t\in[0,T]}$ is the wealth process (2.6) under the portfolio strategy $\theta^{*,f}$.
